title: Email reminders
intro: Godet emails you when a due date is approaching or has passed, and for as long as a repair stays open, in each of your companies.
loadError: Your reminder settings could not be loaded.
signedOut: Sign in to set up your reminders.

enabled.label: Receive email reminders
enabled.hint: They are sent to the email address of your account.

operator: {operatorOnly, select, true {As an operator, you only receive reminders if you turn them on and save them here.} other {In companies where you are an operator, reminders are only sent once these settings are saved.}}

quotidien.label: Every day
quotidien.hint: One email in the morning, only when there is something to report.

hebdo.label: Every week
hebdo.hint: A summary on Monday morning, only when there is something to report.

lead.hint: A due date appears in the reminder as soon as it falls within these limits, and stays there until the work is done.

days.label: Calendar due dates
days.error: Enter a whole number of days, from 1 to 90.

hours.label: Hour-meter due dates
hours.hint: From 5 to 500 hours. Based on how much the machine is used, a due date may also appear earlier if it falls within the limit in days.
hours.error: Enter a whole number of hours, from 5 to 500.

errors.network: No connection. Please check your network and try again.
errors.session: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign in again.
errors.generic: Saving failed. Please try again in a moment.

neverSent: No reminder has been sent yet.
